title: 财富分配之思
text:
“贫富差距已经严重影响社会稳定。”
这句话引发了广泛讨论。当前全球经济增长迅速，但资源集中度极高。少数人掌握绝大部分资产，而底层民众生活艰苦。这种现象之所以存在，是因为资本积累具有自我增强的特性。财富越多，获取新收益的机会就越多。
与此同时，教育资源的不均衡加剧了阶层固化。优质资源集中在都市，导致农村青年难以通过学习改变命运。许多人之所以感到绝望，是因为上升通道被逐渐堵塞。
有人主张通过提高税率来调节。他们认为高额遗产税能有效防止财富过度集中。然而，反对者担心这会打击投资积极性，导致经济活力下降。
单纯依赖行政手段并非良策。真正的解决之道在于创造公平竞争的环境。政府应优化制度，确保每个个体都能获得基本机会。
社会正义不意味着绝对平均。它要求的是合理的分配机制。如果差距过大，消费能力将萎缩，最终损害整体利益。
我们需要重新审视成功定义。单纯追求金钱积累，会导致道德缺失。一个健康的社会应当兼顾效率与公平。唯有如此，才能实现可持续发展。

questions.prompt: According to the text, why does capital accumulation have a “self-reinforcing” characteristic?
options: Because the more wealth one has, the more opportunities one gets to obtain new gains
Because governments guarantee wealth growth by law
Because poor people automatically receive subsidies that eliminate inequality
Because wealth has no effect on future opportunity

questions.prompt: What do proponents of a high inheritance tax argue?
options: It can effectively prevent excessive concentration of wealth
It will eliminate poverty within a year
It has no effect on wealth distribution
It should replace all other forms of taxation

questions.prompt: What concern do opponents of higher taxation raise?
options: It might hurt investment enthusiasm and reduce economic vitality
It would have zero economic impact
It would only affect government employees
It would increase educational inequality

questions.prompt: According to the text, what does “social justice” mean in this context?
options: A reasonable distribution mechanism, not absolute equality
Everyone receiving exactly the same income
Complete elimination of all taxation
Only the wealthy having a say in policy

questions.prompt: What does the text say happens if the wealth gap becomes too large?
options: Consumption ability shrinks, ultimately harming overall societal interest
The economy grows faster indefinitely
Education becomes universally accessible
Social stability automatically improves

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.
